slides.h1: 3 things to fix before you hit Submit.
slides.lead: Apple rejected my app 7 times. Mostly for these.
Not for bugs. Not for design. For the boring stuff most devs leave for last.
If people can share content or message each other, Apple wants clear terms — and a way to report and block.
Link it in App Store Connect and inside the app. It should match what your app actually collects.

slides.h2: Sign up in the app? Delete in the app.
slides.lead: If users can create an account, they need to be able to delete it from inside the app too.
